introHtml: Custom lanyards with a zipper offer a secure way to carry keys, ID badges, or small essentials without worrying about items falling out. Unlike standard lanyards, the zippered pouch adds an extra layer of protection, making them ideal for trade shows, conferences, or daily office use. Choose from various colors and imprint options to match your brand.
